description: This file contains test fixture code for unit testing the WebAudioPlayerService component. It sets up mock objects, expectations, and helper methods to facilitate testing various functionalities such as play, pause, setEos, getBufferAvailable, getBufferDelay, writeBuffer, getDeviceInfo, setVolume, getVolume, and lifecycle management of WebAudioPlayer instances within the service.
